sources.title: Cooling PV modules with hydrogel-coated paper
sources.excerpt: A Vietnamese research team has developed a low-cost passive cooling system for PV modules based on hydrogel-coated paper that combines water flow and interfacial evaporation to reduce operating temperatures.
